svg.aria-label: HQDM 0.0.1-alpha as one connected graph of 490 terms, with 23 terms used as a class but never declared, 12 ranges naming a relation, and 13 names separated only by a trailing underscore.
svg.text: hqdm-0.0.1-alpha.ttl: coherent, and not well formed
1 · 23 terms are used as a class and never declared
2 · 12 rdfs:range declarations name a relation, not a class
3 · 13 names differ only by a trailing underscore, 3 of them identical
1094 triples, 210 declared classes, 490 terms in one connected graph. No owl: term and no disjointness axiom, so no named class can be unsatisfiable and a coherence check returns zero.
WHAT A REASONER CANNOT SEE HERE
used as a class in subClassOf, domain or range; never rdf:type rdfs:Class
rdfs:range must name a class. these name part_of and participant_in
one trailing underscore apart, carrying no meaning. 3 share domain AND range

This is not the file OM-2026 measured. That one, hqdm.owl, carries 14 disjointness axioms and 39 natively unsatisfiable classes. Same ontology, two shipped renderings, and the defect you find depends on which you fetched.
